findings.summary: harness.py:138 duplicate-submission check compares deduped.kind.value to a string literal instead of applying _canonical_kind first; reviewer called this fragile/obscuring intent given the documented cross-generation TerminalStateKind landmine
findings.primary_agent_verification: rejected as false positive: TerminalStateKind.value is a plain Python str, identical across every class generation (all generations compile the same terminal_state.py source text), so `.value == "duplicate_terminal_submission"` cannot produce a false positive/negative from generation drift -- this is the exact, deliberate mechanism the module docstring's "Canonical-kind landmine" section documents and justifies (`.value` string equality is explicitly called out as safe without _canonical_kind; only Artifact(kind=...) construction and category dispatch need it). Applying _canonical_kind here would be equivalent in effect and strictly more code for no behavior change.

findings.summary: harness.py:142 check_path_containment(parsed.candidates, ...) assumes candidates is always present/iterable for a submission kind; reviewer hypothesized malformed/empty/None candidates reaching this line
findings.primary_agent_verification: rejected as false positive: tool_call_parser.py's _parse_submit_vulnerable_files (lines 87-106, read in full during implementation) rejects a missing, non-list, empty, or non-string-list candidates field as MALFORMED_SUBMIT_PAYLOAD/MALFORMED_TOOL_CALL before ever returning SUBMITTED_VULNERABLE_FILES; a TerminalState of that kind is structurally guaranteed to carry a non-empty tuple[str, ...]. This upstream file is read-only in T2e's approved scope, so the guarantee cannot be altered by this task.

findings.summary: harness.py:163 argv-backfill assumes command_state.argv is always non-empty when validate_command succeeds
findings.primary_agent_verification: rejected as false positive: command_policy.py's validate_command (read in full during implementation) rejects an empty argv immediately (`if not argv: return _rejected_shell_syntax("")`) before any success path; COMMAND_PLAN_VALID is structurally guaranteed non-empty argv.
